task:
Use chrome-use to connect to the user's existing Chrome. This is attempt using a DIFFERENT, safer technique than before — CDP's native file-chooser interception, which is the standard Playwright/Puppeteer pattern and does NOT touch the page DOM or dispatch any synthetic events, so it can't bubble into unrelated page state (like the video list checkboxes that caused problems before).

Technique:
1. Enable Page domain, call `Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog({enabled: true})` on the target.
2. Navigate to studio.youtube.com (Vibe Technologies channel — verify correct account).
3. Click the real "Create" button, then "Upload videos" — this triggers Chrome's native OS file-picker, which CDP intercepts as a `Page.fileChooserOpened` event instead of actually opening a picker window.
4. When you receive `Page.fileChooserOpened` (gives you a backendNodeId for the file input), call `DOM.setFileInputFiles({files: ["/tmp/ocm_short_final.mp4"], backendNodeId: <id from event>})`. This sets the file directly on the browser-native input element without any DOM/JS mutation or synthetic event — Chrome fires the real trusted `change` event itself, which is what YouTube's upload UI actually expects and won't misinterpret as a bulk-select action elsewhere on the page.
5. Screenshot after file attaches (should show thumbnail in modal).
6. Fill title "OpenCode Mobile — AI coding agent in your pocket #Shorts", description "Chat with an AI coding assistant from your phone. Connect to your own opencode server, or try the built-in demo. Free & open source. #opencode #AI #coding #mobiledev #Shorts", visibility Public, defaults elsewhere.
7. Publish, capture the video ID/URL, screenshot.
8. Close tab / leave on safe dashboard page.

If chrome-use's underlying CDP session doesn't expose Page.setInterceptFileChooserDialog / Page.fileChooserOpened / DOM.setFileInputFiles as raw commands, check if there's an `eval` or raw-CDP escape hatch in the tool to issue these three CDP commands directly (many browser MCP tools expose a generic `sendCommand` for exactly this kind of case). Try that before giving up.

If truly unavailable in this toolset (no raw CDP passthrough at all), STOP and say so precisely — do not fall back to synthetic DOM events. In that case, note exactly what CDP/eval capabilities the tool DOES expose so we know for certain what's possible here.

Return: success (video ID/URL) or precise capability blocker, screenshot paths, final tab state (must be 1 tab or 0 extra tabs).
